PDF Bates Stamper

Stamp sequential Bates numbers (PREFIX-000001) on every page corner — the legal document numbering standard.

–

–

The stamp is drawn permanently onto each page. Everything runs in your browser.

📖 How to use

  1. Choose a PDF file.
  2. Set the prefix, starting number and digit width.
  3. Pick which corner gets the stamp.
  4. Click "Stamp" and download the numbered PDF.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What is Bates numbering?

Bates numbering is the legal-industry standard for uniquely numbering pages across documents: a fixed prefix plus a zero-padded sequence.

Is the stamp permanent?

Yes — the stamp is drawn onto each page's corner in the exported PDF, permanently.

Can I start at a number other than 1?

Choose the starting number and the digit width (e.g. 6 digits → 000001).
